title: 基于指令微调小语言模型的渐进式老年金融诈骗增量风险评估
summary: 提出一种基于对话轮次的累积风险评估框架，通过逐步聚合对话轮次并重新评估风险，实现动态诈骗监控。构建了包含投资、慈善、技术支持等场景的多轮对话数据集，并微调了Phi-4、LLaMA-3.2等小语言模型，在资源受限环境下实现有效的诈骗检测，支持隐私保护的端侧部署。
summary_en: Proposes a cumulative turn-based risk assessment framework that incrementally aggregates conversational turns to detect financial scams targeting older adults. Constructs a multi-turn dialogue dataset and fine-tunes small language models (Phi-4, LLaMA-3.2, etc.), achieving effective risk estimation suitable for resource-constrained, on-device deployment.
